name: gargantua-schwarzschild-raytracer
description: Real-time Schwarzschild black hole raytracer — null geodesics integrated per pixel in a fragment shader, with a relativistic accretion disc, HDR bloom and ACES grading. Vanilla ES modules, no build step.

scripts.test: node tools/validate.mjs && node tools/i18n-audit.mjs && node tools/checkimports.mjs && node tools/shadow-theory.mjs && node tools/glslcheck.mjs
